records.name: Rafe Magnet
records.biography_en: Rafe Magnet works the Recovery Detail with The Bent Bolt Detail. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Rafe Magnet takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Rafe Magnet has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
